entries.zh: 最顶端；最高处（指此物之最上部）
entries.en: the very top; the highest part (of this)
entries.notes: L 栏「alos lomias altos deſto」残损难读，义据 H「頂頂」及 M/R 对音 tèng tèng 定

entries.en: on top of; above; the upper surface (of something)

entries.zh: 头顶；天灵盖（头之最高处）
entries.en: the crown of the head; the top of the head
entries.notes: H 栏字面作「頭長」，与 L「coronilla」不合，据 L 义与 M/R 首音节（頭 têû）定

entries.zh: 高如天；至高、在上（「宇」谓天宇，覆临万物）
entries.en: high as heaven, i.e. supreme, exalted (宇: the heaven-vault)
entries.notes: L「çoſᵗᵉ」为 esto es 之缩写；「宇」本义为空间、天宇，其「高」义与下条「宇宙」对举而定

entries.en: the universe; high and low, i.e. heaven and earth

entries.notes: H/M/R 三栏皆空，L 仅存词头 Afillar（afilar，磨利），无对音可校

entries.zh: 轮流；按日轮值（依次相代）
entries.en: to alternate; to take turns in order, by day

entries.zh: 轮流；轮班（同伴之间依次轮替）
entries.en: to take turns, as companions do; to rotate

entries.zh: 轮流；轮替（守其次序相代）
entries.en: to alternate in turn, keeping order
entries.notes: H 栏作「輪宇」且自注疑为「字」，L 句止于「guardando」未完，第二字义未能定

entries.zh: 照亮；发光（亦指火光、光亮）
entries.en: to give light, to illuminate; light, fire

entries.zh: 照见；照亮使显现（置于光下）
entries.en: to bring to light; to shine upon so as to be seen

entries.zh: 使心开窍；启悟人心、去其蒙昧（「開心」）
entries.en: to enlighten the heart; to undeceive
entries.notes: L「defenganan」当为 desengañan（去迷误），拼写残损，义据 H「開心」与上下文推

entries.en: (of the sun) to shine; to illumine

entries.zh: 知觉与运动（感觉与行动之能力）
entries.en: perception and motion; the sensitive faculty (sense and movement)
entries.notes: L「A. lueodrio」残损，疑为 albedrío（自由意志），与 H「知覺運動」不合，释义从 H/R
H 栏空缺，R 栏仅「yno.」，M 栏存两种读法，L「Ally」无从定夺

entries.zh: 乳母；奶妈（「乳奶」谓哺儿之妇）
